title: checkpoint2_authorization.json — created ONLY by the key holder
description: Input record for lab.data.authz.verify_authorization. Every hash is re-verified against independently RECOMPUTED values at run time; stale or fabricated values refuse (audit-logged). Consumption is established by the hash-chained state ledger, never by this file.

user_authorization_utc.description: UTC timestamp when the key holder authorizes

protocol_sha256.description: must equal sha256(EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md) recomputed at run time

git_commit.description: must equal `git rev-parse HEAD` of the checkout at run time

frozen_inputs_manifest_file.description: D69 blocker 2: must name exactly checkpoint2_frozen_inputs.json — the ONE manifest pinning every consumed file (governing docs, dataset/partition manifests, frozen recipient, model artifacts); the gate recomputes every pinned hash BEFORE the atomic claim and refuses missing/additional/substituted/symlinked/path-escaping inputs

frozen_inputs_manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of data/manifests/checkpoint2_frozen_inputs.json, recomputed at run time

external_root_hash.description: must equal build_state.json .approved_external_root_hash (the externally preserved APPROVED root)

consumed.description: input flag only; the ledger is authoritative
